voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.32 s, no tempo change

lines.text: Bukas pa 'yung milk tea shop kagabi. Pero anim na buwan na pala itong sarado.
lines.beat_before: hook: the lit shopfront at night from my scooter; the queue inside turns its heads to me at once, bodies still

lines.text: Rider ako. Alas-dos ng madaling-araw, may booking: dalawang milk tea, sa shop sa kanto.
lines.beat_before: the dark corner, one shop lit; my scooter pulls up

lines.text: Bukas ang ilaw. May pila. Lahat nakaharap sa counter. Walang gumagalaw. Walang nagsasalita.
lines.beat_before: inside, behind the queue: backs, still; nobody moves

lines.text: Ngumiti ang crew. Hindi siya kumukurap. Inabot niya ang order ko, at ang resibo.
lines.beat_before: the crew at the counter: the smile, the sealer, the receipt

lines.text: Paglabas ko, lumingon ako. Nakatingin silang lahat sa akin. Pero nakaharap pa rin ang katawan nila sa counter.
lines.beat_before: walking out, I look back: every head turned round to me, the bodies still facing the counter

lines.text: Kinabukasan, dumaan ako. Naka-kandado. Maalikabok. Anim na buwan na raw sarado, sabi ng guard.
lines.beat_before: day: the same shopfront, shutter down, padlocked, dust; the guard

lines.text: Pero nasa bulsa ko pa ang resibo. Petsa kagabi. Alas-dos.
lines.beat_before: my hand: the receipt from my pocket, the date

lines.text: Sa likod, may sulat-kamay: "Balik ka, sir. Kulang pa ang pila."
lines.beat_before: night again: the shop lit, the queue with a gap for me; the crew at the glass, her head snaps to the lens
